title: Cover meets Robbins while Betting on Bounded Data: $\ln n$ Regret and Almost Sure $\ln\ln n$ Regret
abstract: arXiv:2604.20172v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Consider betting against a sequence of $[0,1]$-valued observations using bets that are fair if the data have a conditional mean $m_0 \in (0,1)$. Cover's universal portfolio algorithm achieves a worst-case regret of $O(\ln n)$ compared to the best constant bet in hindsight, and this logarithmic order is unimprovable against adversarial data. We construct an explicit full-support Robbins mixture that combines insights from Robbins and Cover. It retains $O(\ln n)$ regret on every path while also eventually satisfying $R_n\le(1+o(1))\ln\ln V_n$ on every path with bounded mixture wealth and $V_n\to\infty$, where $V_n$ is an intrinsic variance process. It also attains the optimal asymptotic wealth growth rate under iid alternatives. Under the conditional-mean claim and almost-sure divergence of $V_n$, the sharper regret bound holds almost surely, and its leading constant $1$ is unimprovable. translated_title: 在有界数据上下注时当Cover遇上Robbins：ln n 遗憾与几乎必然的 ln ln n 遗憾
translated_abstract: 考虑对一列取值于 [0,1] 的观测序列进行下注，当数据具有条件均值 m₀ ∈ (0,1) 时所采用的注注是公平的。Cover 的通用投资组合算法相比事后最优的常数下注策略可获得 O(ln n) 的最坏情况遗憾，且该对数阶在面对对抗性数据时已是不可改进的。我们构造了一个显式的、具有完全支撑集的 Robbins 混合策略，融合了 Robbins 与 Cover 两者的思想。该策略在每条路径上都保持 O(ln n) 的遗憾，同时对于混合财富有界且 Vₙ → ∞ 的每条路径，最终满足 Rₙ ≤ (1+o(1)) ln ln Vₙ，其中 Vₙ 是一个内在方差过程。在独立同分布的备择假设下，该策略还达到了最优的渐近财富增长率。在条件均值假设及 Vₙ 几乎必然发散的条件下，更精细的遗憾界几乎必然成立，且其首项常数 1 是不可改进的。
tldr: 本文提出一种融合 Cover 与 Robbins 思想的显式完全支撑混合下注策略，在保持 O(ln n) 最坏情况遗憾的同时，在内在方差过程发散的路径上实现几乎必然的 ln ln Vₙ 量级且首项常数不可改进的更精细遗憾界。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs an explicit full-support Robbins mixture betting strategy combining insights from Cover and Robbins, which retains O(ln n) worst-case regret while achieving an almost sure Rₙ ≤ (1+o(1)) ln ln Vₙ regret bound with an unimprovable leading constant on paths where the intrinsic variance process diverges.
